cd /workspace && cat > dev/test_bigreplay.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import ref_replay
rng=random.Random(31)
nodes=['n%02d'%i for i in range(64)]
caps=dict((n,rng.randint(0,30)) for n in nodes)
flows=[]
for i in range(512):
    k=rng.randint(2,9)
    path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
    H=rng.randint(8,60)
    nd=rng.randint(0,H-5)
    kinds=['D']*nd+['Q','T']+['K']*(H-2-nd)
    rng.shuffle(kinds)
    tmpl=bytes(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(H))
    flows.append(dict(id='f%03d'%i,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=''.join(kinds),
                      labels=[rng.randint(16,1048575) for _ in path]))
events=[]
n=20000
for j in range(n):
    r=rng.random(); f=rng.choice(flows)
    if r<0.30: events.append(dict(op='put',flow=f['id'],node=rng.choice(f['path'])))
    elif r<0.45: events.append(dict(op='enable',flow=f['id']))
    elif r<0.55: events.append(dict(op='disable',flow=f['id']))
    elif r<0.58: events.append(dict(op='reset'))
    else:
        H=len(f['template'])//2; kinds=f['kinds']; tmpl=bytes.fromhex(f['template'])
        hdr=bytearray(tmpl)
        for i,c in enumerate(kinds):
            if c!='K': hdr[i]=rng.randint(0,255)
        hdr[kinds.index('Q')]=rng.randint(0,9); hdr[kinds.index('T')]=rng.randint(0,12)
        pl=rng.randint(0,60)
        events.append(dict(op='packet',flow=f['id'],header=bytes(hdr).hex(),payload=bytes(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(pl)).hex()))
req=dict(mode='replay',capacities=caps,flows=flows,events=events)
line=json.dumps(req)
print('input size %.2f MB'%(len(line)/1e6))
exp=ref_replay.run(req)
st=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=(line+'\n')*4,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=200)
el=time.time()-st
outs=r.stdout.splitlines()
print('out lines',len(outs),'out size %.1f MB'%(len(r.stdout)/1e6),'elapsed %.2f'%el,'rc',r.returncode)
got=json.loads(outs[0])
print('match:', got==exp, 'active',len(got['active']),'tables',len(got['tables']))
if got!=exp:
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(got['results'],exp['results'])):
        if a!=b: print('first diff at',i,a,b); break
PYEOF
